name: PayFast Live Runtime Gate
purpose: Prevent real payment activation until PayFast account verification, sandbox ITN proof, runtime configuration, and founder approval are complete.
blockingReality: PayFast account must be approved by PayFast.
Provider credentials must be configured outside source control.
Notify, return, and cancel URLs must point to the correct staging or live Kingsmen endpoints.
A real PayFast sandbox checkout and ITN proof must pass before live activation.
Founder approval is required before production-risk payment activation.
